About the Fresno Cycling Club Monthly Birthday Rides group ride

The Fresno Cycling Club, going since 1962, runs a monthly birthday ride with B, C and C/D groups heading into the foothills toward Millerton, Humphreys or Tollhouse. Each group has a leader. The club rates rides by pace and terrain so you can pick the right one.
